resources.string: Reads only the package name of the app in front.

F/LAB uses this to know which app is in front, so the system-wide fold effect can stand down over banking apps, the camera and other protected surfaces. It reads only the package name. It does not read screen contents, text, or anything you type.
Shown while F/LAB can apply its fold effect outside its own app.
Fold motion applies across the system. Tap to open, or stop it here.
A background that bends at the hinge as you open and close the device, with glass-style time, battery and fold status. Uses no photo of yours — the art is generated on-device.
